Config Class

The Config class is used to store the PHPCore configuration for both the local and master configurations. It will load the master configurations from the ini files. It can be used later to view/modify the local config at runtime.

See also

PHPCore Config Functions - PHPCore internal config functions that interface directly with this class.

Config Class Synopsis

final class Config {

    /* Static Methods */
    public static function get(string $option): mixed
    public static function getAll(?string $extension = null, ?bool $details = true): ?array
    public static function initialize(array $config = []): void
    public static function restore(string $option): void
    public static function set(string $option, mixed $value): mixed

}

Config Class Table of Contents

  • Config::get - Get the value of a configuration option

  • Config::getAll - Get all configuration options for an extension

  • Config::initialize - Initialize

  • Config::restore - Restore value of a configuration option

  • Config::set - Set the value of a configuration option

Config Class Methods

get(string $option)

Get the value of a configuration option

Returns the value of the configuration option.

Note

Returns null if configuration option does not exist.

Parameters

  • $option (string) – The configuration option name.

Returns

mixed Returns the value of the configuration option on success.

Example 10 Get the value of a configuration option
1<?php
2
3use \PHPCore\Config;
4
5// Get by option
6echo Config::get('session.save_handler'); // 'files'
7var_dump(Config::get('env_ini_allowed')); // true
8
9?>

Back to list

getAll(?string $extension = null, ?bool $details = true)

Get all configuration options for an extension

Returns all the registered configuration options.

Note

Returns null if configuration extension does not exist.

Parameters

  • $extension (?string) – An optional extension name. If not null the function returns only options specific for that extension. Default null (retrieve all options).

  • $details (?bool) – Retrieve details settings or only the current value for each setting. Default is true (retrieve details).

Returns

?array Returns an associative array with directive name as the array key.

Example 11 Get all configuration options for an extension
 1<?php
 2
 3use \PHPCore\Config;
 4
 5// Get all by option
 6var_dump(Config::getAll('session', false));
 7// array(19) {
 8//   ["session.enabled"]=>
 9//   bool(true)
10//   ["session.save_handler"]=>
11//   string(5) "files"
12//   ...
13//)
14
15// Get all by option
16var_dump(Config::getAll('session'));
17// array(19) {
18//   ["session.enabled"]=>
19//   array(2) {
20//     ["local"]=>
21//     bool(true)
22//     ["master"]=>
23//     NULL
24//   }
25//   ["session.save_handler"]=>
26//   array(2) {
27//     ["local"]=>
28//     string(5) "files"
29//     ["master"]=>
30//     NULL
31//   }
32//   ...
33//)
34
35?>

initialize(array $config = [])

Initialize

This method is used to initialize the PHPCore config and is called in the bootstrap file. It can be used to pass the runtine configuration via setting the $phpcore_runtime_config array BEFORE the bootloader is loaded.

Parameters

  • $config (array) – Runtime configuration.

Returns

void

Throws

ConfigException Config already initialized.

Throws

ConfigException Config could not be loaded.

Throws

ConfigException Option type not set.

Throws

ConfigException Option declared as string, but is array.

Throws

ConfigException Option type unknown.

Example 12 Using PHPCore runtime config
1<?php
2
3// [phpcore.ini]
4// session.auto_start = No
5
6$phpcore_runtime_config = [ 'session.auto_start' => 'Yes' ];
7include getenv('PHPCORE_BOOTSTRAP');
8
9?>

Back to list

restore(string $option)

Restore value of a configuration option

Restores a given configuration option to the master value that was declared in the phpcore.ini files.

Parameters

  • $option (string) – The configuration option name.

Returns

void

Example 13 Restore value of a configuration option
 1<?php
 2
 3// [phpcore.ini]
 4// session.auto_start = No
 5// response.powered_by = "PHPCore"
 6
 7$phpcore_runtime_config = [ 'session.auto_start' => 'Yes' ];
 8include getenv('PHPCORE_BOOTSTRAP');
 9
10Config::set('response.powered_by', 'MyApp')
11echo Config::get('response.powered_by'); // 'MyApp'
12
13Config::restore('session.auto_start');
14Config::restore('response.powered_by');
15
16echo Config::get('session.auto_start'); // false
17echo Config::get('response.powered_by'); // 'PHPCore'
18
19?>

Back to list

set(string $option, mixed $value)

Set the value of a configuration option

Sets the value of a given configuration option and will return the original previous value on success and null on failure.

Note

Will return null if the option cannot be cahnged durring runtime.

Parameters

  • $option (string) – The configuration option name to set.

  • $value (mixed) – The new value for the option.

Returns

mixed Returns the old value on success, null on failure.

Throws

ConfigException Option type not set.

Throws

ConfigException Option declared as string, but is array.

Throws

ConfigException Option type unknown.

Example 14 Set the value of a configuration option
 1<?php
 2
 3// [phpcore.ini]
 4// version_lock = "1.0"
 5// response.powered_by = "PHPCore"
 6
 7include getenv('PHPCORE_BOOTSTRAP');
 8
 9echo Config::set('response.powered_by', 'MyApp'); // 'PHPCore'
10echo Config::get('response.powered_by'); // 'MyApp'
11
12var_dump(Config::set('version_lock', '1.1')); // null
13echo Config::get('version_lock'); // '1.0'
14
15?>
